en.s: The Battle of Sirmium, Battle of Semlin or Battle of Zemun (Hungarian: zimonyi csata) was fought on July 8, 1167 between the Byzantine Empire, and the Kingdom of Hungary. The Byzantines achieved a decisive victory, forcing the Hungarians to sue for peace on Byzantine terms. The battle consolidated Byzantine control of the western Balkans.

zh.s: 锡尔米乌姆战役，也称塞姆林战役或泽蒙战役（匈牙利语：zimonyi csata），于1167年7月8日爆发，交战双方是拜占庭帝国和匈牙利王国。拜占庭军队取得决定性胜利，迫使匈牙利按拜占庭提出的条件求和。此战巩固了拜占庭对巴尔干半岛西部的控制。

en.s: The Battle of Malta took place on 8 July 1283 in the entrance to the Grand Harbour, the principal harbour of Malta, as part of the War of the Sicilian Vespers. An Aragonese fleet of galleys, commanded by Roger of Lauria, attacked and defeated a fleet of Angevin galleys commanded by Guillaume Cornut and Bartholomé Bonvin. The Angevin ships arrived in Malta first, and proceeded to relieve the Angevin garrison, which was besieged within the walls of the Castello del Mare. The galleys were followed in close pursuit by an Aragonese fleet.

zh.s: 马耳他海战于1283年7月8日在马耳他主要港口大港湾入口处爆发，是西西里晚祷战争的一部分。鲁杰罗·迪·劳里亚指挥的阿拉贡桨帆船舰队袭击并击败了纪尧姆·科尔努和巴尔托洛梅·邦万指挥的安茹桨帆船舰队。安茹舰船先抵达马耳他，随后解救了被围困在海堡（Castello del Mare）城墙内的安茹守军。之后，阿拉贡舰队紧追这些桨帆船而来。

en.s: The 1526 battle of Nashinokidaira (梨の木平の戦い) was one of many battles fought between the Takeda and Hōjō clans in Japan's Sengoku period. On 8 July of that year, the battle was won by Takeda Nobutora over Hōjō Ujitsuna.

zh.s: 1526年的梨木平之战（日语：梨の木平の戦い）是日本战国时代武田氏与北条氏之间多场战斗之一。该年7月8日，武田信虎在战斗中击败北条氏纲。

en.s: Kett's Rebellion was a revolt in the English county of Norfolk during the reign of Edward VI, largely in response to the enclosure of land. It began at Wymondham on 8 July 1549 with a group of rebels destroying fences that had been put up by wealthy landowners. One of their targets was yeoman Robert Kett who, instead of resisting the rebels, agreed to their demands and offered to lead them.

zh.s: 凯特起义发生在爱德华六世统治时期的英格兰诺福克郡，主要缘于土地圈占。1549年7月8日，起义在温德姆爆发，起义者拆毁富裕地主修建的围栏。他们原本也把自耕农罗伯特·凯特列为目标，但凯特没有抵抗，而是接受起义者的要求并提出领导他们。

en.s: The Battle of Oldendorf (German: Schlacht bei Hessisch-Oldendorf ) on 8 July 1633 was fought as part of the Thirty Years' War between the Swedish Empire and the Holy Roman Empire near Hessisch-Oldendorf, Lower Saxony, Germany. The result was a decisive victory for the Swedish Army.

zh.s: 奥尔登多夫战役（德语：Schlacht bei Hessisch-Oldendorf）于1633年7月8日爆发，是三十年战争的一部分。瑞典帝国与神圣罗马帝国在德国下萨克森州黑森-奥尔登多夫附近交战，瑞典军队取得决定性胜利。

en.s: The siege of La Capelle took place from the 2nd to the 8th of July in 1636 during the Franco-Spanish War (1635–1659) in which a Spanish army under Cardinal-Infante Ferdinand managed to seize the fortress of La Capelle from the French army retreating from a previous defeat taking place at Leuven.

en.s: The Battle of Makhnivka took place between the Cossack-peasant army led by Maksym Kryvonis and the Polish–Lithuanian forces led by Jeremi Wiśniowiecki, it took place during 6–8 July in 1648, ending in Cossack victory.

en.s: The Battle of Walk on July 8, 1657 between forces of Sweden commanded by Friedrich von Löwen on one side, and Russian forces led by Matvey Sheremetyev on the other side. The largest part of the Russian army disobeyed Sheremetev and left the battle at the beginning, forcing him to rely on the 250 reiters of Colonel Denis Fonvizin, who played the key role in the breakthrough and allowed the rest of the army to escape. The Swedish forces won the battle.

zh.s: 瓦尔加战役发生于1657年7月8日，交战双方是弗里德里希·冯·勒文指挥的瑞典军队和马特维·谢列梅捷夫指挥的俄军。俄军大部分部队不听从谢列梅捷夫的命令，在战斗开始时便离开战场，迫使他只能依靠丹尼斯·冯·冯维辛上校指挥的250名骑兵。骑兵在突破中发挥了关键作用，使俄军其余部队得以逃脱。瑞典军队赢得了这场战斗。

en.s: The attack on Kronstadt occurred on 8 July 1704 during the Great Northern War. After the construction of Kronslot on the newly captured island of Kotlin by Russia, a Swedish fleet of 1–2 ship(s) of the line, 5–8 frigates, 5 brigantines, several smaller ships, and 1,000 men sailed towards the island. The Swedes landed on the island, proceeding to defeat 500 Russian troops stationed in 2 redoubts and took their artillery.

zh.s: 喀琅施塔得袭击战发生于1704年7月8日，是大北方战争的一部分。俄军刚在新占领的科特林岛上建成克朗斯洛特要塞，瑞典舰队便驶向该岛，舰队包括1至2艘战列舰、5至8艘护卫舰、5艘双桅纵帆船、多艘小型船只和1,000名士兵。瑞典军队登岛后击败了驻守两座棱堡的500名俄军，并夺取了火炮。

en.s: The Tunisian–Algerian War of 1705 was a military conflict between the Beylik of Tunis and the Regency of Algiers. The Regency wanted to cripple Tunis' power due to their participation in the Maghrebi War.

en.s: The Battle of Poltava fought on 8 July 1709, was the decisive and largest battle of the Great Northern War. A Russian army under the command of Tsar Peter I defeated a Swedish army commanded by Carl Gustaf Rehnskiöld. The battle would lead to the Swedish Empire losing its status as a European great power and also marked the beginning of Russian supremacy in eastern Europe.

zh.s: 波尔塔瓦战役于1709年7月8日爆发，是大北方战争中具有决定性意义、规模最大的一场战役。彼得一世沙皇率领俄军击败了卡尔·古斯塔夫·雷恩舍尔德指挥的瑞典军队。这场战役使瑞典帝国失去欧洲强国地位，也标志着俄罗斯开始称霸东欧。

en.s: The naval Battle of Dynekilen (Danish: Slaget ved Dynekilen) took place on 8 July 1716 during the Great Northern War between a Dano-Norwegian fleet under Peter Tordenskjold and a Swedish fleet under Olof Strömstierna. The battle resulted in a Dano-Norwegian victory.

zh.s: 迪内基伦海战（丹麦语：Slaget ved Dynekilen）于1716年7月8日在大北方战争期间爆发。托登舍尔德率领丹麦-挪威舰队，与奥洛夫·斯特伦谢尔纳率领的瑞典舰队交战，最终丹麦-挪威获胜。

en.s: The Action of 8 July 1716 was an indecisive naval battle that took place on 8 July 1716 during a Turkish attempt to capture the island of Corfu (Kerkyra), off the west coast of mainland Greece.

en.s: The 1730 Valparaíso earthquake occurred at 04:45 local time (08:45 UTC) on July 8. It had an estimated magnitude of 9.1–9.3 and triggered a major tsunami with an estimated magnitude of Mt 8.75, that inundated the lower parts of Valparaíso. The earthquake caused severe damage from La Serena to Chillán, while the tsunami affected more than 1,000 km (620 mi) of Chile's coastline.

zh.s: 1730年7月8日当地时间4时45分（世界协调时8时45分），瓦尔帕莱索发生地震，估计震级为9.1至9.3级，并引发强烈海啸，估计海啸震级为Mt 8.75。海啸淹没了瓦尔帕莱索低洼地区。地震从拉塞雷纳到奇廉造成严重破坏，海啸则影响了智利海岸线超过1,000公里（620英里）的区域。

en.s: The siege of Azov (1736) was fought during the Austro-Russian–Turkish War (1735–39) and ended with the Russian capture of Turkish Azov Fortress. On the Russian side, the land siege was commanded sequentially: Münnich (30 Mar – 6 Apr), Levashov (6 Apr – 15 May), Lacy (15 May – 8 Jul); the force of the Navy was led by Bredal.

en.s: The Battle of Restigouche was a naval battle fought in 1760 during the Seven Years' War (known as the French and Indian War in the United States) on the Restigouche River between the British Royal Navy and the small flotilla of vessels of the French Navy, Acadian militia and Mi'kmaq militias.

en.s: The invasion of Algiers was a massive and disastrous amphibious attempt in July 1775 by a combined Spanish and Tuscan force to capture the city of Algiers, the capital of the Regency of Algiers. The amphibious assault was led by Spanish general Alexander O'Reilly and Tuscan admiral Sir John Acton, commanding a total of 20,000 men along with 74 warships of various sizes and 230 transport ships carrying the troops for the invasion.

zh.s: 1775年7月，西班牙与托斯卡纳联军发动大规模两栖远征，试图攻占阿尔及尔摄政区首府阿尔及尔城，但行动以灾难性失败告终。此次两栖进攻由西班牙将军亚历山大·奥赖利和托斯卡纳海军上将约翰·阿克顿爵士率领，共有20,000名士兵、74艘各型军舰和230艘运兵船。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Anne, fought on July 8, 1777, was an engagement between Continental Army forces in retreat from Fort Ticonderoga and forward elements of John Burgoyne's much larger British army that had driven them from Ticonderoga, early in the Saratoga campaign of the American Revolutionary War. Burgoyne, surprised by the American withdrawal from Fort Ticonderoga, hurried as many of his troops as possible forward in pursuit of the retreating Americans.

zh.s: 安妮堡战役于1777年7月8日爆发。美国大陆军从提康德罗加堡撤退时，与约翰·伯戈因率领、规模大得多的英军先头部队交战。伯戈因对美军撤离提康德罗加堡感到意外，随即尽可能派兵追击撤退中的美军。这场战斗发生在美国独立战争萨拉托加战役的早期阶段。

en.s: The Battle of Alkhan–Yurt, or the Battle of Alkhanov was a military engagement between the Russian troops led by Brigadier Fyodor Apraksin and the villagers of the Chechen village of Alkhan–Yurt as well as volunteers from Aldy. Brigadier Apraksin was originally supposed to help the Pieri detachment at Aldy but arrived too late and was ambushed by Chechen fighters when trying to capture the village Alkhan–Yurt.

zh.s: 阿尔汗尤尔特战斗（又称阿尔汗诺夫战斗）是俄军与车臣村庄阿尔汗尤尔特的村民及来自阿尔迪的志愿者之间的一次军事交战。费奥多尔·阿普拉克辛准将原本奉命支援驻在阿尔迪的皮耶里支队，但他抵达时已太晚；在试图攻占阿尔汗尤尔特时，遭车臣战士伏击。

en.s: The Battle of Gefrees was fought on 8 July 1809 during the War of the Fifth Coalition between a joint force of Austrians and Brunswickers under the command of General Kienmayer and a French force under the command of General Junot, Duke of Abrantès. The battle ended in victory for the Austrians who avoided being trapped by Junot and a force of Saxons and Westphalians led by Jérôme Bonaparte, King of Westphalia.

zh.s: 格弗雷斯战役于1809年7月8日爆发，是第五次反法同盟战争的一部分。基恩迈尔将军率领奥地利与不伦瑞克联军，对阵阿布朗泰斯公爵、法国将军朱诺率领的法军。奥军获胜，避免被朱诺以及由威斯特伐利亚国王热罗姆·波拿巴率领的萨克森和威斯特伐利亚部队合围。

en.s: The Combat of Stockerau was a minor rearguard cavalry skirmish fought by elements of the cavalry of Austrian VI Korps of the Kaiserlich-königliche Hauptarmee under Ludwig von Wallmoden-Gimborn against a single Hessian Guard Chevauleger regiment, under the command of French General Jacob François Marulaz. The combat ended in favour of the Austrians.

zh.s: 施托克劳交战是一场小规模的骑兵后卫战。奥地利皇帝皇家主力军第六军团的部分骑兵，在路德维希·冯·瓦尔莫登-金博恩指挥下，与一支黑森近卫轻骑兵团交战；该团由法国将军雅各布·弗朗索瓦·马鲁拉指挥。战斗以奥军获胜告终。

en.s: The Battle of Ball's Farm took place on July 8, 1813, during The War of 1812. A British and Native force successfully recovered medical supplies they buried on the Chourous farm a few kilometres from Fort George, Ontario. The medicine supplies were buried in the face of an advancing American army. During the recovery an American force of 500 sortied from the occupied Fort George.

zh.s: 鲍尔农场战役于1813年7月8日爆发，是1812年战争的一部分。英军与原住民部队成功取回了埋在安大略省乔鲁斯农场的医疗物资；农场距乔治堡数公里。当时美军正在推进，因此这些药品此前被埋藏起来。取回物资期间，一支由500人组成的美军从占领中的乔治堡出击。

en.s: The Waterloo campaign, also known as the Belgian campaign (15 June – 8 July 1815) was fought between the French Army of the North and two Seventh Coalition armies, an Anglo-allied army and a Prussian army. Initially the French army had been commanded by Napoleon Bonaparte, but he left for Paris after the French defeat at the Battle of Waterloo.

zh.s: 滑铁卢战役也称比利时战役，发生于1815年6月15日至7月8日，交战双方是法兰西北方军与第七次反法同盟的两支军队：英军及其盟军组成的联军和普鲁士军队。最初，法军由拿破仑·波拿巴指挥；滑铁卢战败后，他离开军队前往巴黎。

en.s: The Battle of Pagallos (Spanish: Batalla de Pagallos), or, alternatively Pagayos, was a battle on 8 July 1817 during the Venezuelan War of Independence. In the battle, ships under Antonio Díaz carrying materiel to Simón Bolívar's Patriot army were attacked by eleven Royalist ships in the Orinoco, near the island of Pagallos. Patriots took heavy losses but successfully forced Royalists out of the Orinoco.

zh.s: 帕加约斯战役（西班牙语：Batalla de Pagallos，也称Pagayos）于1817年7月8日爆发，是委内瑞拉独立战争的一部分。安东尼奥·迪亚斯率船队沿奥里诺科河运送物资，支援西蒙·玻利瓦尔的爱国者军队；船队在帕加约斯岛附近遭到11艘保王党船只袭击。爱国者部队损失惨重，但成功将保王党军队逐出奥里诺科河。

en.s: The Russo-Persian War of 1826–1828 was the last major military conflict between the Russian Empire and Qajar Iran, which was fought over territorial disputes in the South Caucasus region. Initiated by Russian expansionist aims and intensified by Iranian resistance, the war witnessed significant military engagements, including the Battle of Ganja and Capture of Erivan. The Iranians were initially successful, catching the Russian forces of Yermolov off-guard.

en.s: The Battle of Boonsboro took place on July 8, 1863, in Washington County, Maryland, as part of the Retreat from Gettysburg during the Gettysburg Campaign of the American Civil War. While Gen. Robert E. Lee's Army of Northern Virginia retreated toward Virginia following its defeat in the Battle of Gettysburg, Confederate cavalry held the South Mountain passes. en.s: Partial general elections were held in Belgium on 10 June, 17 June and 8 July 1884. The result was a victory for the Catholic Party, which won 86 of the 138 seats in the Chamber of Representatives and 43 of the 69 seats in the Senate. Voter turnout was 79.1%, although only 69,276 people were eligible to vote. Under the alternating system, elections for the Chamber of Representatives were only held in five out of the nine provinces: Antwerp, Brabant, Luxembourg, Namur and West Flanders. Special elections were held in the arrondissements of Aalst and Sint-Niklaas, for one representative in each.

Robert Bruce, who had previously been the MP for Rangitikei between 1884 and 1890, won the by-election narrowly.

en.s: The attack on Chaves, which occurred on July 8, 1912, was a military action performed by supporters of the monarchy of Portugal in opposition to the Portuguese First Republic, which had been proclaimed two years prior. The attack was led by Henrique Paiva Couceiro, who had campaigned in Africa and who had become the leader of the royalists. The royalists had been discreetly armed by the Spanish king, Alfonso XIII, and had concentrated their forces in Galicia. The attack ended with a defeat for the royalist forces.

zh.s: 沙维什袭击是葡萄牙君主派支持者反对葡萄牙第一共和国的一次军事行动，发生于1912年7月8日。当时葡萄牙第一共和国成立仅两年。袭击由恩里克·派瓦·库塞罗领导；他曾在非洲参加军事行动，后来成为保皇派领袖。保皇派由西班牙国王阿方索十三世暗中提供武器，并将兵力集中在加利西亚。袭击以保皇派战败告终。

en.s: The Kuomintang (KMT) is a major political party in the Republic of China (Taiwan). zh.s: 中国国民党（KMT）是中华民国（台湾）的主要政党。1928年至1949年间，它是中国大陆的唯一执政党，直至迁往台湾；在台湾则实行戒严统治，直至1987年。国民党属于中间偏右至右翼政党，是泛蓝联盟中规模最大的政党；泛蓝联盟是台湾两大政治阵营之一。

en.s: Mwambutsa IV Bangiricenge (6 May 1912 – 26 March 1977) was the penultimate king (mwami) of Burundi who ruled between 1915 and 1966. He succeeded to the throne on the death of his father Mutaga IV Mbikije (reigned 1908–15). Born while Burundi was under German colonial rule, Mwambutsa's reign mostly coincided with Belgian colonial rule (1916–62). The Belgians retained the monarchs of both Rwanda and Burundi under the policy of indirect rule.

zh.t: 布隆迪国王姆瓦姆布察四世在政变中被其子、王子查尔斯·恩迪齐废黜
zh.s: 姆瓦姆布察四世·班吉里琴热（1912年5月6日—1977年3月26日）是布隆迪倒数第二位国王（mwami），于1915年至1966年在位。他在父亲穆塔加四世·姆比基耶（1908—1915年在位）去世后继承王位。姆瓦姆布察出生时布隆迪仍处于德国殖民统治之下，其统治时期大多与比利时殖民统治（1916—1962年）重合。比利时人奉行间接统治政策，保留了卢旺达和布隆迪两国的君主。

en.s: The Canadian federal election of 1974 was held on July 8, 1974 to elect members of the Canadian House of Commons of the 30th Parliament of Canada. The governing Liberal Party was reelected, going from a minority to a majority government, and gave Prime Minister Pierre Trudeau his third term. The Progressive Conservatives, led by Robert Stanfield, did well in the Atlantic provinces, and in the West, but the Liberal support in Ontario and Quebec ensured a majority Liberal government.

zh.s: 加拿大于1974年7月8日举行联邦大选，选出加拿大第30届议会的众议院议员。执政自由党再次当选，从少数派政府转为多数派政府，皮埃尔·特鲁多因此开启第三个总理任期。罗伯特·斯坦菲尔德领导的进步保守党在大西洋省份和西部表现不错，但自由党在安大略省和魁北克省获得的支持确保其赢得多数。

zh.t: 俄罗斯航空4225号班机空难
zh.s: 1980年7月8日，俄罗斯航空4225号班机执行从阿拉木图机场（现阿拉木图）飞往辛菲罗波尔机场的定期国内客运航班。这架图-154B-2飞机爬升时遭遇热气流，升至不超过500英尺的高度后，空速突然下降。

en.t: West Germany v France (1982 FIFA World Cup)
en.s: West Germany v France was a FIFA World Cup semi-final match that took place in the Estadio Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán stadium in Seville, Spain on 8 July 1982. The match was won by West Germany on penalty kicks (5–4); West Germany advanced to face Italy in the final. Thanks to its back-and-forth drama, four goals in extra time, and a dramatic penalty shootout, this game is regarded not only as the best of the 1982 tournament, but one of the best World Cup games of all time. It is considered by French captain Michel Platini to be his "most beautiful game."

zh.t: 西德对阵法国（1982年国际足联世界杯）
zh.s: 西德对阵法国是1982年国际足联世界杯的一场半决赛，于1982年7月8日在西班牙塞维利亚的拉蒙·桑切斯·皮斯胡安球场举行。西德队在点球大战中以5比4获胜，晋级决赛对阵意大利队。比赛剧情跌宕起伏，加时赛打进4球，点球大战也十分紧张；这场比赛被认为是1982年世界杯的最佳比赛，也是世界杯历史上最佳比赛之一。法国队长米歇尔·普拉蒂尼称这是他“最美妙的一场比赛”。

en.s: The Dujail massacre was the mass killing of Shia civilians by the Ba'athist Iraqi government between 8 July 1982 and 1985 in Dujail in Iraq. The mass killing was committed in retaliation for an assassination attempt by the Iranian-backed Islamic Dawa Party on the President of Iraq, Saddam Hussein. The town of Dujail had a large Shia population, with 75,000 residents at the time of the incident, and was a well-known stronghold of the Dawa Party.

zh.s: 1982年7月8日至1985年间，伊拉克复兴党政府在伊拉克杜杰尔大规模杀害什叶派平民。这场杀戮是对伊朗支持的伊斯兰达瓦党企图刺杀伊拉克总统萨达姆·侯赛因的报复。当时杜杰尔有75,000名居民，其中什叶派人口众多；该镇也是达瓦党众所周知的据点。

en.s: STS-65 was a Space Shuttle program mission of Columbia launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida, 8 July 1994. The flight carried a crew of 7 and was commanded by Robert D. Cabana who would go on later to lead the Kennedy Space Center. STS-65 was an international science mission that carried the International Microgravity Laboratory (IML-2) on a 15-day mission which featured the first animals (Japanese rice fish) to conceive and bear offspring in space.

zh.s: STS-65是美国航天飞机计划的一次任务，哥伦比亚号于1994年7月8日从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心发射升空。机上有7名乘员，由罗伯特·D·卡巴纳担任指令长；他后来出任肯尼迪航天中心主任。STS-65是一项国际科学任务，搭载国际微重力实验室二号，执行为期15天的任务。任务中，日本青鳉鱼成为首批在太空受孕并产下后代的动物。

en.s: Sudan Airways Flight 139 was a Sudan Airways passenger flight that crashed on 8 July 2003 at Port Sudan. The Boeing 737-200 aircraft was operating a domestic scheduled Port Sudan–Khartoum passenger service. en.s: A general election was held in Grenada on 8 July 2008.Out of a total of fifteen seats, the opposition National Democratic Congress (NDC) won eleven seats and the governing New National Party (NNP) won four seats, thus bringing the NDC to power for the first time since 1995. STS-135 launched on July 8, 2011, and landed on July 21, 2011, following a one-day mission extension. The four-person crew was the smallest of any shuttle mission since STS-6 in April 1983.

en.s: Guerra de Empresas (2012) (Spanish for "War of the Promotions") was an annual professional wrestling major event produced by Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), which took place on July 8, 2012 in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico. The event focused on an eight-tag team tournament between representatives of IWRG, Asistencia Asesoría y Administración (AAA), Desastre Total Ultraviolento (DTU), La Familia de Tijuana (FdT) and Los Perros del Mal (PdM) to underline the "War of the Promotions" concept.

zh.s: 推广联盟大战（Guerra de Empresas，西班牙语意为“推广联盟之战”）是由墨西哥职业摔角推广组织国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）主办的年度大型赛事，于2012年7月8日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。赛事围绕一项八支双打队伍参加的锦标赛展开，参赛队伍分别代表IWRG、摔角协助与管理公司（AAA）、全面毁灭暴力摔角（DTU）、蒂华纳家族（FdT）和恶犬帮（PdM），突出“推广联盟之战”这一主题。

en.s: Destination X (2012) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) promotion, which took place on July 8, 2012 at the Impact Wrestling Zone in Orlando, Florida. It was the eighth show under the Destination X chronology and seventh event in the 2012 TNA PPV schedule. Unlike last year, the event was held inside of a four-sided ring as opposed to a six-sided ring. The main event featured at the Destination X was Austin Aries defeating Bobby Roode for the TNA World Heavyweight Championship.

zh.s: 2012年《Destination X》是职业摔角按次付费赛事，由Total Nonstop Action Wrestling（TNA）主办，于2012年7月8日在佛罗里达州奥兰多的Impact Wrestling Zone举行。这是“Destination X”系列第八场赛事，也是TNA 2012年按次付费赛事安排中的第七场。与上一年不同，本届赛事使用四边形擂台，而不是六边形擂台。主赛中，Austin Aries击败Bobby Roode，赢得TNA世界重量级冠军。

en.s: The 2012 Leinster Senior Hurling Championship final, the deciding game of the 2012 Leinster Senior Hurling Championship, was a hurling match played on 8 July 2012 at Croke Park, Dublin. Contested by Galway and Kilkenny, most experts gave the former little chance against the latter.

zh.s: 2012年伦斯特高级板棍球锦标赛决赛是该届赛事的决胜场，于2012年7月8日在都柏林克罗克公园举行。戈尔韦队对阵基尔肯尼队，大多数专家认为前者胜算不大。

en.s: The 2012 Slovenian Supercup was the eighth edition of the Slovenian Supercup, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Slovenian PrvaLiga and Slovenian Cup competitions. The match was played on 8 July 2012, in Ljudski vrt stadium between 2011–12 Slovenian PrvaLiga runners-up Olimpija Ljubljana and 2011–12 Slovenian PrvaLiga winners Maribor, as Maribor won both the Slovenian Cup and the Slovenian PrvaLiga in the previous season.

zh.s: 2012年斯洛文尼亚超级杯是该项年度赛事的第八届，由上赛季斯洛文尼亚甲级联赛和斯洛文尼亚杯的冠军球队参赛。比赛于2012年7月8日在Ljudski vrt球场举行。由于马里博尔队上赛季同时赢得联赛和杯赛冠军，本场由联赛亚军卢布尔雅那奥林匹亚队对阵联赛冠军马里博尔队。

en.s: The 2011 Liga Indonesia Premier Division final is a scheduled football match played on 8 July 2012 at the Manahan Stadium in Surakarta, Indonesia, to determine the winner of 2011–12 Liga Indonesia Premier Division. PS Barito Putera took the title after defeating Persita Tangerang in the final with a score of 2–1. This was their first premier division title.

zh.s: 2011—2012赛季印尼甲级联赛决赛于2012年7月8日在印度尼西亚梭罗的马纳汉体育场举行，决出该赛季冠军。巴里托普特拉队在决赛中以2比1击败坦格朗佩西塔队，首次赢得顶级联赛冠军。

en.s: The 2012 Moldovan Super Cup was the sixth Moldovan Super Cup (Romanian: Supercupa Moldovei), an annual Moldovan football match played by the winner of the national football league (the National Division) and the winner of the national Cup. The match was played between Sheriff Tiraspol, champions of the 2011–12 National Division, and Milsami Orhei, winners of the 2011–12 Moldovan Cup. It was held at the Sheriff Stadium on 8 July 2012.

zh.s: 2012年摩尔多瓦超级杯（罗马尼亚语：Supercupa Moldovei）是该项赛事的第六届。这项年度足球比赛由全国足球联赛（国家甲级联赛）冠军对阵摩尔多瓦杯冠军。本届比赛由2011—2012赛季国家甲级联赛冠军蒂拉斯波尔警长队对阵摩尔多瓦杯冠军奥尔海伊米尔萨米队，于2012年7月8日在警长体育场举行。

en.s: The 2012 Wimbledon Championships was a tennis tournament played on grass courts at the All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club in Wimbledon, London in the United Kingdom. It was the 126th edition of the Wimbledon Championships and was held from 25 June to 8 July 2012. It was the third Grand Slam tennis event of the year and was part of the ATP World Tour, the WTA Tour, the ITF Junior Tour and the NEC Tour.
en.n: It was the 126th edition of the Wimbledon Championships and was held from 25 June to 8 July 2012.

zh.s: 2012年温布尔登网球锦标赛是在英国伦敦温布尔登全英草地网球和门球俱乐部草地球场举行的网球赛事。这是第126届温布尔登锦标赛，于2012年6月25日至7月8日举行，也是当年第三项大满贯网球赛事。赛事属于ATP世界巡回赛、WTA巡回赛、ITF青少年巡回赛和NEC巡回赛。

en.s: On the morning of 8 July 2013 at the Republican Guard headquarters in Cairo, Egypt there was a clash between protesters seeking the return of deposed President Mohamed Morsi, and the military, who were protecting the institution. According to the Forensic Medical Authority, at least 61 protesters seeking the return of Morsi to power were killed and more than 435 injured in the clashes, in what has been deemed a massacre by the Muslim Brotherhood and those opposed to the recent coup d'état.

zh.s: 2013年7月8日上午，埃及开罗共和国卫队总部发生冲突。要求被罢黜总统穆罕默德·穆尔西复职的示威者与守卫该机构的军方发生对峙。法医管理局称，至少61名要求穆尔西复权的示威者在冲突中死亡，另有超过435人受伤。穆斯林兄弟会及反对近期政变的人士将这场冲突称为大屠杀。

en.t: Brazil v Germany (2014 FIFA World Cup)
en.s: The Brazil versus Germany football match that took place on 8 July 2014 at the Estádio Mineirão in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, was the first semi-final match of the 2014 FIFA World Cup. Both Brazil and Germany reached the semi-finals with an undefeated record in the competition, with the Brazilians' quarter-finals with Colombia causing them to lose striker Neymar to injury, and defender and captain Thiago Silva to accumulation of yellow cards. Despite the absences, a close match was expected, given both teams were traditional FIFA World Cup forces, sharing eight tournaments won and having previously met in the 2002 FIFA World Cup Final, where Brazil won 2–0 and earned their fifth title.

zh.t: 巴西对阵德国（2014年国际足联世界杯）
zh.s: 巴西对阵德国的足球比赛于2014年7月8日在巴西贝洛奥里藏特的米内罗体育场举行，是2014年国际足联世界杯的首场半决赛。巴西队和德国队晋级半决赛前都保持不败。巴西队在四分之一决赛对阵哥伦比亚时，前锋内马尔受伤，后卫兼队长蒂亚戈·席尔瓦则因累计黄牌停赛。尽管两队都缺少关键球员，外界仍预计比赛会十分胶着，因为两队都是传统强队，合计赢得过8届世界杯；此前两队曾在2002年世界杯决赛交手，巴西队以2比0获胜并第五次夺冠。

en.s: The 2014 Gaza War, also known as Operation Protective Edge (Hebrew: מִבְצָע צוּק אֵיתָן, romanized: Miv'tza Tzuk Eitan, lit. 'Operation Strong Cliff'), and Battle of the Withered Grain (Arabic: معركة العصف المأكول, romanized: Maʿrakat al-ʿAṣf al-Maʾkūl), was a military operation launched by Israel on 8 July 2014 in the Gaza Strip, a Palestinian territory governed by Hamas since 2007 and which was occupied by Israel since 1967 until its disengagement in 2005.

zh.s: 2014年加沙战争又称“护刃行动”（希伯来语：מִבְצָע צוּק אֵיתָן，转写：Miv'tza Tzuk Eitan，意为“坚固岩石行动”）和“吃草之战”（阿拉伯语：معركة العصف المأكول，转写：Maʿrakat al-ʿAṣf al-Maʾkūl），是以色列于2014年7月8日在加沙地带发动的一场军事行动。加沙是巴勒斯坦领土，自2007年起由哈马斯治理；1967年起被以色列占领，直至2005年以色列撤出。

en.s: On the evening of 8 July 2014, five Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades militants, who were members of the Nukhba forces, attempting to infiltrate Israel by swimming from the Gaza Strip to Zikim beach in southern Israel. All five were killed by the IDF.

en.s: The 2015 Supercupa României was the 17th edition of Romania's season opener cup competition. The game was contested between Liga I title holders, Steaua București, and 2nd place holders, ASA Târgu Mureș. It was played at Stadionul Farul in Constanța in July. Târgu Mureș won the trophy for the first time in history, after defeating Steaua, 1–0.

zh.s: 2015年罗马尼亚超级杯是该国足球赛季揭幕杯赛的第17届，由罗马尼亚甲级联赛冠军布加勒斯特星队对阵联赛亚军特尔古穆列什ASA队。比赛于7月在康斯坦察的Farul体育场举行。特尔古穆列什队以1比0击败星队，队史首次赢得该项赛事冠军。

en.s: The 2016 Honduran Supercup was a match arranged by the Honduran Liga Nacional which took place on 8 July 2016 between C.D. zh.s: 洪都拉斯国家联赛于2016年7月8日安排举行超级杯比赛，由2015—2016赛季国家联赛开季赛冠军洪都拉斯普罗格雷索队对阵2015年洪都拉斯杯冠军奥林匹亚体育俱乐部。这是自1999年以来首次举办洪都拉斯超级杯；2015年的赛事已被取消，原因未公开。

zh.s: 2020年斯洛伐克杯决赛（因赞助原因称为Slovnaft杯）是2019—2020赛季斯洛伐克杯的决赛，也是斯洛伐克足球顶级杯赛的第51届赛事。比赛于2020年7月8日在布拉迪斯拉发的Tehelné pole球场举行，由布拉迪斯拉发斯洛万队对阵鲁容贝罗克足球俱乐部。

en.s: The 2020 Ukrainian Cup final decided the winner of the 2019–20 Ukrainian Cup, the 29th season of the annual Ukrainian football cup competition. zh.s: 2020年乌克兰杯决赛决出了2019—2020赛季乌克兰杯冠军，这是该项年度足球杯赛的第29届赛事。比赛于2020年7月8日在哈尔科夫的金属工人体育场举行，由基辅迪纳摩队对阵波尔塔瓦沃尔斯克拉队。这是乌克兰杯决赛第五次在哈尔科夫举行；此前四次分别在2008年、2010年、2013年和2017年。

en.s: The 2022 Madhya Pradesh panchayat elections was held in three phases on 25 June, 1 July and 8 July 2022, in the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh. 39,378,502 voters will elect members to 394,233 posts, across all three tiers of the panchayats, and since Electronic voting machines are not being used, over 575 t (566 long tons; 634 short tons) of paper is expected to be used during the elections.

zh.s: 印度中央邦2022年乡村地方选举分三阶段举行，投票日分别为6月25日、7月1日和7月8日。全邦三个层级的乡村地方机构共有394,233个职位，39,378,502名选民将参与选举。由于不使用电子投票机，预计此次选举将使用超过575吨纸张（566长吨；634短吨）。

en.s: On 8 July 2022, Shinzo Abe, the former prime minister of Japan and serving member of the Japanese House of Representatives, was assassinated while speaking at a political event outside Yamato-Saidaiji Station in Nara City, Nara Prefecture. Abe was delivering a campaign speech for a Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) candidate when he was fatally shot by 41-year-old Tetsuya Yamagami with an improvised firearm.

en.s: The 2023 Major League Rugby Championship Final was the fifth Major League Rugby (MLR) championship match, held at the conclusion of the 6th season of the rugby union club competition in North America. en.s: The 2023 UEFA European Under-21 Championship final was a football match that took place on 8 July 2023 at the Adjarabet Arena in Batumi, Georgia, to determine the winners of the 2023 UEFA European Under-21 Championship. en.s: The 2023 Supercupa României was the 25th edition of the Supercupa României, an annual football super cup contested by the winners of the previous season's Liga I and Cupa României competitions. en.s: Leadership elections occurred in Ireland's Green Party in July 2024, after Eamon Ryan announced his intention to resign as party leader. Ryan, who had led the party since 2011, announced his resignation on 18 June 2024. Following the announcement, deputy leader Catherine Martin announced she would be stepping down as deputy leader, triggering a deputy leadership election. The election was held online over three days.

en.s: The 2024 Supercopa Internacional (officially the Supercopa Internacional Sur Finanzas 2025 for sponsorship reasons) was the third edition of the Supercopa Internacional, an annual football match contested by the winners of the Trofeo de Campeones de la Liga Profesional and the best team in the Argentine Primera División aggregate table for the season. The trophy was contested by Estudiantes (LP) (winners of 2024 Trofeo de Campeones) and Vélez Sarsfield (best team in the 2024 Primera División aggregate table). It was the third final played between both clubs within the last year, with the previous two matches being won by Estudiantes (2024 Copa de la Liga final and 2024 Trofeo de Campeones). The Supercopa Internacional was originally scheduled to be played in Abu Dhabi, but the tournament's organizers, AFA and the Abu Dhabi Sports Council, cancelled the agreement between them and the competition has moved to another venues since then. The match was held on 8 July 2025, at the Estadio Libertadores de América in Avellaneda.

zh.s: 2024年国际超级杯是该项年度赛事的第三届；因赞助原因，官方名称为2025年Sur Finanzas国际超级杯。参赛球队为2024年职业联赛冠军杯冠军拉普拉塔大学生队，以及2024年阿根廷甲级联赛积分榜第一的萨斯菲尔德队。这是两队在不到一年内第三次于决赛相遇；此前两场决赛——2024年联赛杯决赛和2024年冠军杯——均由拉普拉塔大学生队获胜。赛事原计划在阿布扎比举行，但主办方阿根廷足协（AFA）与阿布扎比体育委员会取消了双方协议，此后比赛场地改至其他地点。本场于2025年7月8日在阿韦亚内达的解放者球场举行。
